signals_info.description: Whether ACC is executing cruise or following control.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some future time, the condition acc_active == 1 shall newly become true.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在未来某个时刻，acc_active == 1 这一条件应刚开始成立。
nl_Paraphrase_en: ACC shall engage at some future time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: ACC 应在未来某个时刻启动巡航或跟车控制。
